networkDefense.Vac.Event.description: DDoS mitigation event. It typically starts when the DDoS detection system sends an alert, and the traffic of the subnet is routed through the mitigation system (VAC).

endedAt.description: End date of the event. Null when the event is ongoing.

subnet.description: IP subnet affected by the event

targetSpec.description: Protection configuration to apply to the policy

networkDefense.Vac.PolicyAsyncResource.description: A protection policy within a VAC resource. Changes are applied in the background, so its status shows whether the policy is ready or a change is still being applied.

checksum.description: Checksum of the current configuration, used to detect concurrent changes. Provide it on update to avoid overwriting another change.

createdAt.description: Date and time the policy was created

currentState.description: Configuration currently being enforced. Null while the policy is still being created (CREATING).

errorMessage.description: Details of the last error, set when the status is ERROR

targetSpec.description: Configuration you requested. While a change is being applied (CREATING, UPDATING or ERROR) it differs from currentState. Once READY it mirrors currentState. Null while the policy is being deleted.

updatedAt.description: Date and time the policy was last updated

networkDefense.Vac.PolicyAsyncResourceWi.description: A protection policy within a VAC resource. Changes are applied in the background, so its status shows whether the policy is ready or a change is still being applied.

checksum.description: Checksum of the current configuration, used to detect concurrent changes. Provide it on update to avoid overwriting another change.

createdAt.description: Date and time the policy was created

currentState.description: Configuration currently being enforced. Null while the policy is still being created (CREATING).

errorMessage.description: Details of the last error, set when the status is ERROR

targetSpec.description: Configuration you requested. While a change is being applied (CREATING, UPDATING or ERROR) it differs from currentState. Once READY it mirrors currentState. Null while the policy is being deleted.

updatedAt.description: Date and time the policy was last updated

checksum.description: Checksum returned by the last read, used to detect concurrent changes. A stale value is rejected with HTTP 412.

targetSpec.description: Protection configuration to apply to the policy

networkDefense.Vac.PolicySpec.description: Protection configuration of a policy: its name, the targets it protects, and the profile and sensitivity enforced on those targets

enabled.description: Whether the policy is active. A disabled policy keeps its configuration but does not protect any traffic.

name.description: Name of the policy. Renaming it does not change the protection being enforced.

profileId.description: Identifier of the protection profile, chosen from the available profile catalog

targets.description: The complete set of targets the policy protects, excluding the ones being removed. Only the PREFIX type is available today.

networkDefense.Vac.PolicySpecInput.description: Protection configuration to apply to a policy: its name, the targets to protect, and the profile and sensitivity to enforce on them

enabled.description: Whether the policy is active. Defaults to true.

name.description: Name for the policy. Renaming it does not change the protection being enforced.

profileId.description: Identifier of the protection profile, chosen from the available profile catalog

targets.description: The complete set of targets to protect. Every write fully replaces the previous set: omitting this field or sending an empty list removes every target. At most 1000 entries. Changing only the targets is always accepted, even while another change is still being applied.

networkDefense.Vac.PolicyState.description: Protection configuration currently enforced by a policy, including the targets it currently holds, together with the read-only details of the enforced deployment

enabled.description: Whether the policy is active. A disabled policy keeps its configuration but does not protect any traffic.

name.description: Name of the policy. Renaming it does not change the protection being enforced.

profileId.description: Identifier of the protection profile, chosen from the available profile catalog

profileVersion.description: Version of the enforced configuration, increased each time a change is applied

serviceId.description: Identifier of the VAC resource this policy belongs to

targets.description: The targets currently held by the policy, each with the status of every prefix it protects. Also includes the targets removed from the configuration that are still being taken down, so it can list more targets than the configuration does.

networkDefense.Vac.PrefixDefinition.description: A PREFIX target: a single IP range in CIDR notation

networkDefense.Vac.Profile.description: A VAC profile: an expert-curated protection configuration for a workload type, for example DNS server, web server. Read-only catalog entry, filtered by per-customer eligibility.

description.description: Human-readable description of the profile's intended use case

sensitivities.description: Sensitivity levels offered for this profile

state.description: Lifecycle state of the profile. Only RETIRED blocks new policy assignments.

networkDefense.Vac.ProfileStateEnum.description: Lifecycle state of a VAC profile. Only RETIRED blocks new policy assignments. BETA and DEPRECATED profiles remain selectable.

networkDefense.Vac.ResolvedPrefix.description: One IP prefix protected by a target, with its current status

networkDefense.Vac.Resource.description: A VAC resource groups your anti-DDoS protection policies. It holds no protection settings of its own, so its status only reflects whether it is being deleted.

createdAt.description: Date and time the resource was created

name.description: Name you chose for the resource

resourceStatus.description: Current status of the resource. For a VAC resource this is only ever READY or DELETING.

updatedAt.description: Date and time the resource was last updated

networkDefense.Vac.ResourceUpdate.description: Fields that can be changed on a VAC resource

networkDefense.Vac.ResourceWithIAM.description: A VAC resource groups your anti-DDoS protection policies. It holds no protection settings of its own, so its status only reflects whether it is being deleted.

createdAt.description: Date and time the resource was created

name.description: Name you chose for the resource

resourceStatus.description: Current status of the resource. For a VAC resource this is only ever READY or DELETING.

updatedAt.description: Date and time the resource was last updated

networkDefense.Vac.SensitivityEnum.description: Protection sensitivity level chosen for a policy. A higher sensitivity means tighter detection thresholds and a more aggressive mitigation profile.

networkDefense.Vac.TargetDefinition.description: One target declared in a policy's configuration: what the policy protects. A target is identified by its value, not by an identifier. Only the PREFIX type is available today, so the prefix field must be set.

prefix.description: The IP range for the PREFIX target

networkDefense.Vac.TargetState.description: One target currently held by a policy, with the status of every IP prefix it protects. A target listed here but no longer present in the policy's configuration is being taken down: its prefixes stay DELETING until they are cleared.

id.description: Read-only target identifier. It is not part of the policy configuration: a target is declared by its value.

prefix.description: The IP range, set when the target type is PREFIX

resolved.description: The IP prefixes this target currently protects, each with its status. A PREFIX target always has exactly one entry.

type.description: Type of target, which determines which definition field is set

networkDefense.Vac.TargetStatusEnum.description: Status of a single protected prefix within a policy. Each target protects one or more prefixes, each carrying this status.

networkDefense.Vac.TargetTypeEnum.description: Type of a policy target. Only PREFIX (a single CIDR range) is available today. Other types will be added in the future.

networkDefense.Vac.TrafficResponse.description: DDoS mitigation traffic statistics. All arrays have the same length. The Nth item of the dropped or passed arrays matches the Nth timestamp.

dropped.description: Volume of traffic dropped by the VAC (DDoS protection)

passed.description: Volume of traffic which was not dropped by the VAC (DDoS protection)

get.description: Returns the detection events of the VAC DDoS protection, with their start and end dates and attack vectors when available. Filter by date range, region or subnet. Ongoing events, not finished, can be requested on their own.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Query events which started after the given date

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Query events which ended before the given date

parameters.name: ongoingOnly
parameters.description: Query for ongoing events only. If this is set, `after` and `before` parameters are ignored.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Query events for the given region

parameters.name: subnets
parameters.description: Query events for the given subnets

post.description: Creates a policy within a VAC DDoS protection resource, applying a profile and a sensitivity level to target IP address prefixes in order to tune detection and mitigation rules. Async call, follow resourceStatus for operation progress. A target whose prefix carries protection settings that were not set via a policy is refused, unless you send force=true to overwrite them.

put.description: Updates the name, enabled state, targets, profile and sensitivity level of a policy. The targets sent fully replace the previous ones: an omitted or empty list of targets removes every target from the policy. Removed target IPs reset their VAC DDoS protection settings to the default state. Send the checksum from the last read. A stale value is rejected. A new target whose prefix carries protection settings that were not set via a policy is refused, unless you send force=true to overwrite them.
